note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: 1:1 centre crop is soft: outline and ray edges blurred, not crisp flat art, although silhouette and colours match.
flags.fix: Re-run with an edge-preserving sharpen or nearest-edge plus 1px AA pass instead of bilinear smoothing; keep palette exact.

flags.problem: Fine speckle reads as sandpaper noise rather than stone surface; dark blobs repeat at regular intervals and look stamped.
flags.fix: Lower the lab-inject high-frequency noise and break up the regular blob spacing; keep the dark mortar line and stone shapes.

flags.problem: Dark opening is smeared into a blurry blob at 1:1 and the stone edges around it are mushy.
flags.fix: Restore edge contrast on the opening (less smoothing in the colormatch or lab-inject step); keep the original opening position and size.

flags.problem: Diagonal scratch-like lines and smeared dark blobs read as artifacts rather than stone courses; tileable_guess is false, so seams are a risk.
flags.fix: Remove the diagonal streak artifacts from the streak-aligned crop and keep horizontal course lines; check the left and right edges for a seam.
